Food

What comes to the table

From the menu and from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Meze

Guests who order the meze write that the dishes keep coming, and that a meze for three is easily enough for five.

From the grill

Souvlaki and sheftalia in Cypriot pita, pork chops, lamb chops and a mixed grill for one or two.

Home cooking

Moussaka, kleftiko, beef with onions in wine, pork afelia and stuffed vegetables, served with fries and salad.

Salad and bread first

Guests write that salad and bread come to the table before the meal, from the house.

At the table

Photos from the taverna’s Google listing.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Big portions

51 reviews mention the portions, and several guests took home what they could not finish.

Live music

Live music at the weekends, as the taverna posts on Instagram and the board outside announces. Some guests get up to dance.

Outside and inside

Tables outside in the warm months, under bougainvillea, and a cosy room inside in winter.

At the top of the village

The taverna is a wooden house on Antheon in Oroklini, with blue checked tablecloths, potted plants at the door and tables on the square. Guests write that they come every week with friends, or every time they are back in Cyprus, and some drive over from Limassol for lunch.

What guests say

Three of 296 Google reviews, all three with five stars.

“Top pick in Voroklini village. Great traditional Cypriot menu. Very welcoming, friendly staff. The portions very generous and the flavours were great, just really tasty homecooked food. Best Greek coffee we had all trip.”

Google review
“Great food. Huge portions. Affordable prices. Very good service. Very nice atmosphere. A real Cypriot tavern in the heart of the lovely Oroklini. Highly recommended place.”

Google review
„Klein und gemütlich....typisch griechisch....mit leckerem Essen.. Vorab Salat und Brot vom Haus. Moussaka und Schweinefleisch in Koriander ein Gedicht.“
